strengths.text: Theo hãng: đối tác OEM của 17 hãng động cơ; có tải giả (load bank) đạt TÜV/CE, máy cao thế

quote: KEYPOWER is the registered trademark of Fuzhou GFF KEYPOWER Equipment Co., Ltd., Since 1998, we have designed and manufactured diesel generator sets, load banks, diesel dewatering pumps, energy storage systems and mobile lighting towers

As an OEM partner of Cummins, Perkins, MTU, Volvo Penta, Scania, Deutz, Hyundai, Weichai, Yuchai, Baudouin, SDEC, FAW, Kohler, Kubota, Yanmar, Isuzu and Mitsubishi, KEYPOWER builds generator sets from 5 kVA to 4,000 kVA
ISO 9001 quality management system / ISO 14001 environmental management system
